findings.title: Fallback locale files are not loaded outside ApplicationController requests
findings.body: The fallback backend can only resolve keys from locales whose YAML files have been loaded, but the new fallback locales are explicitly loaded only by ApplicationController#set_locale. Workers, mailers, rake tasks, and any direct I18n.t call do not run that callback; on a fresh process the translation accelerator loads only I18n.locale, then the fallback backend searches the default/en locale before their files have been loaded. As a result, server-side calls can return missing translations instead of falling back, and behavior can vary based on whether an unrelated web request previously loaded those locales. Ensure the complete fallback chain is loaded as part of translation/fallback resolution rather than only in the controller.

findings.title: Changing the site default locale leaves cached fallback translations in the old language
findings.body: The fallback chain now depends dynamically on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the translation accelerator caches no-argument translations using only the requested locale, key, and backend object (lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb lines 71-76). A key requested in a partially translated user locale is cached with the current site-default fallback; after an administrator changes the default locale, the same cache key continues returning the old fallback value until it is evicted or I18n.reload! happens. Invalidate the translation cache when default_locale changes or include the effective fallback configuration in the cache key.
